questions.question: Which of the following best describes the purpose of a join index in a star schema as illustrated in the example?

options.A: To compress the fact table rows for storage efficiency
options.B: To pre‑compute and store relationships between the fact table and dimension tables for faster joins
options.C: To enforce referential integrity between dimensions
options.D: To replace bitmap indexes for high‑cardinality attributes

questions.explanation: A join index stores the relationship between a fact table and its dimension tables to accelerate join operations, as shown in the example. (Source Page: [80])
